first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person with short brown hair and narrow, elongated reddish-brown glasses, wearing a dark grayish-brown suit, white shirt, and black tie, and holding a gun in one hand.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: A person with short black hair and narrow, elongated dark glasses, wearing a long black trench coat, dark top, black pants, and black boots, with wide straps and fasteners around the waist and legs.

entities.name: handgun A
entities.identification: The black handgun held in one hand by Person A and raised forward and upward.

entities.name: handgun group B
entities.identification: The two black handguns initially held separately in Person B's two hands and subsequently released and falling, recorded continuously as one object group.

entities.name: glass-curtain-wall high-rise
entities.identification: The high-rise facade behind Person A, with grayish-cyan, green-tinged reflective glass, wide light-colored columns, and rectangular window panes.

entities.name: brown rooftop equipment structure
entities.identification: The tall, dark brown rectangular equipment structure on the image-left side of Person B, with a grid-like exterior and pipes and red components along its right edge.

entities.name: rooftop surface
entities.identification: The grayish-brown rooftop surface beside Person B's feet and behind Person B, with flat slabs and straight seams.

entities.name: smoke
entities.identification: The gray-white smoke distributed in patches across the rooftop, with uneven density and irregular boundaries.

entities.name: distant city buildings
entities.identification: The light gray city buildings of varying heights behind Person B, with parallel rows of windows visible on some high-rises.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The light gray-blue sky outside the building and above the city buildings, lacking clearly defined cloud boundaries.
